description:
Update the connected TalkJS test app's settings. Supply one or more fields.
Custom fields merge; a null entry deletes that field, and custom: null clears all custom fields.
Requiring authentication needs backend-generated user tokens; making it optional permits impersonation.

authentication.description: Whether users must supply backend-generated authentication tokens.

custom.description: Custom fields to merge. Values are strings or null to delete; null for the whole field clears all custom fields.

defaultLocale.description: Locale, for example en-US or pl; normalized by TalkJS.

name.description: App name; trimmed and must not be empty.

name: update_settings
title: update_settings
